algorithm: PPO using the pinned RLinf Pi0RL flow-SDE actor
parent_selection: Freeze one shared SFT checkpoint using evaluation-two-task-v2.json; require success in both tasks and a fresh zero-update handoff before optimization.

reward.observation_rule: Simulator geometry is used for reward computation only; it never enters the policy observation.

actor_update_evidence: Record gradient norm and changed tensor/element counts plus maximum and L2 changes for action heads, action-expert LoRA and any enabled VLM LoRA. Critic-only changes do not pass.
evaluation: Evaluate the single PPO descendant on both fixed development tasks and the same reserved ordinary and language suites; do not require or invent an improvement.
